info.name: ChatGPT All Pink Aesthetic Theme
info.description: This pink aesthetic theme turns ChatGPT into a stylish, cohesive pink experience. All clickable elements, including buttons, inputs, and links, are now a beautiful shade of pink. The background has a soft blush tone, while the text is elegantly styled in matching pink hues, providing a fun and personalized interface that radiates positive vibes.
info.additionalInfo:
Background Color: #fce4ec (soft blush pink for the main background)
Button Colors: #ec9ec0 (soft pink for buttons), #d78ba9 (hover effect)
Text Color: #ec9ec0 (all text styled in pink)
Hover Effects: Darker shades of pink for interactive elements
Chat Input Box: Soft pink background with accent pink borders
Link Styling: Pink with hover effects for emphasis
